pr.body:
A recreated Cargo target leaves a valid release-owner marker bound to its former inode. Add explicit `./launch --recover-release-target` for this repository's inspected replacement target, requiring Hex already stopped and never requesting quit/force. It updates clean main and uses the normal selective release clean, fresh optimized build and verified installation/start; tests remain opt-in.

Read-only inspection binds exact old-owner SHA256 and replacement directory identity. Under the existing target lock the guard rechecks full workspace/common repository, clean ancestor source, package specs, marker/target/source stability and configured/raw app inactivity before mutation. Historical artifact metadata is never reused as qualification. Default and automatic force-restart identity guards remain unchanged. The flag is incompatible with --open/--force-restart.

Source 93b1ce44e720097b7d3cd5d24efc73ceecb86ade; tree eb710dec297aee864a0743fd02116a9ffbae32f8. Delta on 8d6d9233, the single ordinary main4a078dae integration preserving original canonical412 linkage/history. Ten focused Python/test/documentation files; no Swift/compiler/native-app changes.

Validation: clean exact-source component 9/9 PASS, 22.336s. Complete Python suite: 239 total, 237 passed, two existing macOS-signature skips. Includes twelve new real-Runner/private-filesystem recovery tests and fixture Cargo artifact/ready path, race/foreign/malformed/busy/running-app refusal, CLI routing, Python3.9 grammar and existing architecture/style/vendor/provenance/layout/fmt/diff guards. Original diagnostic and test-harness setup failures preserved separately.

Outstanding: merger's prospective full21 and fresh review/merge; Root's actual Mac recovery. No native app was built, installed, launched or signalled here. Cooperative locks do not cover arbitrary external writers/raw Cargo.
